description: Curated, source-reviewed counterfactual reviewer and gate judgments for tier-routing evaluation. This is an unmeasured instrument: no score, routing claim, or model ranking is implied until the pre-registered observation run completes.

items.prompt: Style review. The rule is that public functions use descriptive names. A change renames `f` to `parse_invoice_total`. Return only `pass` when the change follows the rule, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. The module has no use of `json`; a change adds `import json`. Return only `pass` when the change follows the rule that imports are used, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. Nearby code spaces binary operators. A change replaces `total=left+right` with `total = left + right`. Return only `pass` when it follows that convention, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A public parameter named `customer_identifier` is renamed to `x` without a local convention requiring it. Return only `pass` when the change preserves descriptive public names, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. The project uses one blank line between top-level functions. A change inserts exactly one blank line between two top-level functions. Return only `pass` when compliant, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A parser change catches `except:` and silently returns an empty object. Return only `pass` when it follows the rule to avoid bare exception handlers, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A function annotated `-> int` always returns an integer count. Return only `pass` when this annotation matches the function behavior, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. `if index < len(rows): return rows[index]` guards an indexed lookup. Return only `pass` when this prevents an out-of-range access for index equal to len(rows), otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A loop changes from `for i in range(n):` to `for i in range(n - 1):` while it must process every element. Return only `pass` when behavior is preserved, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. `amount = subtotal + tax` replaces an earlier expression with the same operands and operator. Return only `pass` when the computed amount is unchanged, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A validation branch changes `if password is None:` to `if password:` while an empty password must be rejected by a later validator. Return only `pass` when the behavior is equivalent, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A cache lookup uses `cache.get(key)` and computes a value only when the result is `None`; cached values are never None. Return only `pass` when this is correct, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A division changes from `value / count` to `value / (count - 1)` without changing the stated denominator. Return only `pass` when correct, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A predicate returns `status == "ready"` for the requirement that only ready records proceed. Return only `pass` when correct, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The done-when says a command exits 0; the captured command exits 0. Return only `pass` when the evidence satisfies this criterion, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The criterion requires a focused test and a full suite. Only the focused test output is supplied. Return only `pass` when the criterion is satisfied, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The required artifact is `docs/guide.md`; the review supplies that exact file with the required heading. Return only `pass` when the artifact criterion is met, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A requirement says at least 20 candidates; the report shows 19. Return only `pass` when the numeric threshold is met, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The requirement is a non-empty provenance field for every item; all listed items have non-empty provenance. Return only `pass` when the criterion is met, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The requirement says do not overwrite an existing output; the command overwrote one. Return only `pass` when the requirement is met, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A project uses `Path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")`; a change replaces a bare `open(path)` call with that established form. Return only `pass` when convention is followed, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. The function handles user input. A change logs the raw password in a debug statement. Return only `pass` when the change follows safe logging practice, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A two-branch expression is moved into a clearly named helper used once to remove duplicated validation logic. Return only `pass` when readability improves without obscuring behavior, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A change replaces an existing named constant `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S` with literal `540` and adds no explanation. Return only `pass` when it follows the local naming convention, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A public function keeps its documented parameter order while adding an optional keyword-only parameter with a default. Return only `pass` when API readability and compatibility are preserved, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A change adds a 20-line comment that repeats exactly what an obvious three-line loop does. Return only `pass` when the comment improves maintainability, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. The surrounding module uses immutable tuples for constant choices; a change also defines its constant choices as a tuple. Return only `pass` when it follows the local convention, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A function must retain zero as a valid setting. It changes `if limit is None:` to `if not limit:`. Return only `pass` when behavior is preserved for limit=0, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. The code needs a copy before mutation. It changes `next_state = state.copy()` to `next_state = dict(state)` for a flat mapping. Return only `pass` when the required shallow copy is preserved, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. An error handler changes `raise` to `return None` after catching a database failure, but callers distinguish failure from absent data. Return only `pass` when behavior is preserved, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A de-duplication loop checks `if value not in seen:` then adds it and appends it. Return only `pass` when it preserves first-occurrence order, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. An end-exclusive slice `[start:end]` is changed to `[start:end + 1]` though the caller expects end-exclusive behavior. Return only `pass` when correct, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A UTC timestamp is parsed as timezone-aware UTC and compared with another timezone-aware UTC timestamp. Return only `pass` when the comparison avoids naive-time ambiguity, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A retry loop catches every `Exception`, including a deliberate `CancelledError`, then retries. Return only `pass` when cancellation behavior is preserved, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. The criterion requires an artifact and a test proving it is consumed. Both the artifact and a passing consumer test are supplied. Return only `pass` when this satisfies the criterion, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A plan says endpoint health must be observed live; a configuration file merely names the endpoint. Return only `pass` when the evidence is sufficient, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. The required check is strict typing. The output says `Success: no issues found`. Return only `pass` when this is direct evidence of the required check, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A criterion says every declared source path must be relative. One declaration is `C:\absolute\file.json`. Return only `pass` when the criterion is satisfied, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A bug fix requires a regression test failing before the fix and passing after it; the review includes both outcomes. Return only `pass` when the evidence meets the requirement, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A claim requires a pre-registered production run. The only evidence is a unit test with mocked responses. Return only `pass` when the claim can be promoted, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. The project uses explicit `None` checks for optional values. A change replaces `if result is not None:` with `if result:` even though zero is a meaningful result. Return only `pass` when style and semantics remain clear, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A long conditional is extracted into `is_retryable_transport_error(exc)`, whose name states the policy and whose tests cover its cases. Return only `pass` when this abstraction improves clarity, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A module aliases `pathlib.Path` as `P` despite nearby code importing `Path` directly. Return only `pass` when the change follows the local naming convention, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A `match` statement handles all documented enum variants and ends with an explicit unreachable default. Return only `pass` when the control flow is clear and defensive, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A change adds a generic helper named `process_data` that accepts `Any` and hides three unrelated operations. Return only `pass` when this is a clear abstraction, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A default factory is used for a dataclass list field instead of `[]` at class definition. Return only `pass` when it follows the project-safe mutable-default convention, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A method changes a stable keyword argument from `timeout_s` to `t` solely to shorten a call site. Return only `pass` when readability for callers is preserved, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A function removes duplicate IDs using a set but must preserve input order; it appends an ID only on its first encounter. Return only `pass` when the requirement is met, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. The function must distinguish an absent JSON key from a key holding null. It changes `payload.get("limit")` to direct indexing without a fallback. Return only `pass` when behavior is preserved for absent keys, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A transactional update performs validation before writing either record, and rolls back on a write failure. Return only `pass` when partial state cannot be committed, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A sort key changes from `(priority, created_at)` to `(created_at, priority)` while consumers require priority grouping first. Return only `pass` when output ordering is preserved, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A reader snapshots a configuration object before a loop, and all loop decisions use that snapshot. Return only `pass` when mid-loop external edits cannot create inconsistent decisions, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A cache key uses only `user_id` although results also vary by requested locale. Return only `pass` when the cache cannot return the wrong locale, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A parser validates an object against a schema before reading required fields from it. Return only `pass` when malformed input is rejected before field use, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A criterion demands a test through the production CLI entry point. The implementation has direct function tests only. Return only `pass` when the criterion is met, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. The requirement is that malformed input fails loudly. The test asserts a distinct exception and no output artifact appears. Return only `pass` when sufficient evidence is present, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A user-visible status must reflect unavailable versus zero. The test checks only a numeric zero rendering. Return only `pass` when both states are proven distinct, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. The plan requires a schema version rejection for newer artifacts. A test supplies version 99 and observes a visible error. Return only `pass` when this criterion is met, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. The requirement says never execute a source artifact. The implementation reads bytes but the review has no test or code path proving it avoids execution. Return only `pass` when the evidence proves the invariant, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A completion condition requires a fresh source-hash audit. The report includes all citations and an audit command that passed after the edits. Return only `pass` when the freshness condition is met, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A compatibility shim retains an old parameter name but marks it deprecated and forwards it to the descriptive replacement with a warning. Return only `pass` when the API transition is clear, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A change converts five explicit domain branches into a compact nested conditional whose branches have no names. Return only `pass` when readability improves for maintainers, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. Error text adds an actionable remediation command but does not expose secrets or internal stack details. Return only `pass` when the message is useful and safe, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A helper takes `dict[str, object]` and returns `dict[str, object]` even though a stable dataclass exists for this domain. Return only `pass` when the change preserves the local typed boundary, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A function accepts a `Path`, avoids converting it to a string until the I/O boundary, and uses the project path helper. Return only `pass` when it follows the surrounding path convention, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A change uses a global mutable list to remember request-specific warnings across calls. Return only `pass` when this is an appropriate local-state design, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A private helper is named after its effect, has a narrow typed signature, and is placed beside the sole public caller. Return only `pass` when this is maintainable organization, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A concurrent refresh records the generation number before fetching and applies results only if the generation still matches. Return only `pass` when an older fetch cannot overwrite newer state, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A request timeout is passed in milliseconds to an API that expects seconds, without conversion. Return only `pass` when the configured timeout behavior is correct, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A merge operation first checks both versions share a base revision, then applies non-overlapping edits only. Return only `pass` when divergent bases cannot be silently combined, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. An authorization cache stores an allow decision keyed only by user, though access also depends on organization. Return only `pass` when cross-organization access cannot leak, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A streaming parser keeps incomplete trailing bytes and prepends them to the next chunk before decoding. Return only `pass` when a multibyte character split across chunks is preserved, otherwise `flag`.
Correctness review. A cleanup `finally` block deletes a temporary directory even when its path was never initialized. Return only `pass` when this cannot mask the original error, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A database migration writes a marker only after every data transformation and verification step succeeds. Return only `pass` when retries cannot treat a partial migration as complete, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A plan requires all executable configuration keys to be rejected. Tests cover one executable key but not the remaining declared key family. Return only `pass` when the full requirement is proven, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A producer must preserve unavailable and real-zero values. The test supplies both inputs and asserts different serialized states through the public API. Return only `pass` when the criterion is proven, otherwise `flag`.
Gate decision. A report claims every row was freshly observed, but its data source is a hand-authored fixture marked illustrative. Return only `pass` when the claim is justified, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A required symlink-escape test creates a link to an external file and verifies the public loader rejects it before reading. Return only `pass` when the security criterion is satisfied, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A result reports a passing endpoint check based only on a TCP connection, while the requirement is a successful authenticated model call. Return only `pass` when the higher-level health claim is proven, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A migration criterion requires old snapshots to deserialize and new snapshots to serialize. Regression tests cover both directions with stable fixtures. Return only `pass` when the compatibility criterion is met, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A short change replaces a well-named `is_enabled_for_project` predicate with `enabled`, but the latter captures a stale outer variable and hides the project argument. Return only `pass` when the refactor remains clear and local, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. To keep a compatibility boundary explicit, a function returns a typed result object containing either a value or an error code rather than a magic sentinel. Return only `pass` when this preserves clarity at the boundary, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A change moves a security exception into a broad shared `except Exception` block because it reduces duplicate lines. Return only `pass` when the resulting error policy remains explicit, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A parser returns a discriminated union with named `valid`, `invalid`, and `unavailable` states, and callers switch on the state. Return only `pass` when this makes absence distinct from a zero-like value, otherwise `flag`.
Style review. A highly compressed expression combines parsing, validation, and mutation through chained side effects. Return only `pass` when it improves local maintainability, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A documentation note describes why a non-obvious freshness cap exists and links it to the exact validation code, without repeating implementation details. Return only `pass` when this is useful durable documentation, otherwise `flag`.

Style review. A helper called `safe_read` returns an empty string for a malformed file and also for a real empty file, without a status field. Return only `pass` when the name and result contract remain unambiguous, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A freshness check compares an artifact timestamp to the scan start time, but clocks may move backward. It rejects only timestamps strictly older than the configured maximum age measured from scan start. Return only `pass` when the stated freshness rule is applied deterministically, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A resolver calls `Path.resolve()` then checks only that the resulting string starts with the workspace string; workspace `/work/a` and path `/work/ab/x` are possible. Return only `pass` when containment is securely proven, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A cache stores `(source_hash, parsed_value)` and reparses whenever the current source hash differs. Return only `pass` when a changed artifact cannot reuse stale parsed evidence, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A JSON decoder catches a recursion-depth error and returns the same shape used for a valid empty document. Return only `pass` when a hostile nesting input remains visibly distinguishable from real empty data, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A run resume operation validates the run ID against a complete safe-name pattern before joining it below the runs directory. Return only `pass` when `../../outside` cannot traverse outside, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A scorer receives an ambiguous response containing both `pass` and `flag` without a structured verdict; it chooses the first word. Return only `pass` when this follows a fail-safe deterministic verdict contract, otherwise `flag`.

Correctness review. A source loader rejects a symlink before opening the file and then verifies the resolved path remains below the allowed root. Return only `pass` when both escape defenses are present, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A benchmark report shows 100 percent for one model, but all items were authored from that model's prior outputs and no provenance diversity was checked. Return only `pass` when the report justifies a routing decision, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A claimed result includes the suite content hash, full roster, pre-registration, terminal row count, and per-model error/defer rates. Return only `pass` when these are the required observation record components, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. An implementation test confirms a renderer returns HTML, but the plan requires hostile detail IDs to be visibly rejected through the browser route. Return only `pass` when the route-level criterion is proven, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A real endpoint check returns unavailable and the UI renders `Unavailable` rather than zero; the telemetry record retains the reason. Return only `pass` when unavailable has not been fabricated as a real zero, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A calibration loop replaces all-pass items, changes their text, and compares the new mean directly to the old suite mean without a version/content hash boundary. Return only `pass` when the comparison remains valid, otherwise `flag`.

Gate decision. A later rubric judge disagrees with deterministic gold, and the report preserves both results while retaining the deterministic outcome as the routing evidence. Return only `pass` when this avoids self-judging circularity, otherwise `flag`.
